nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionProposalReview.tsx
nodes.summary: Review surface for a generated knowledge-extraction proposal: renders editable title, summary, and content fields with a markdown edit/preview toggle, and exposes the approve-as-new-bubble, update-existing-bubble, and reject resolutions.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses useId-generated field identifiers and a controller prop rather than local server state, keeping the extraction state machine as the single owner of the workflow.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionProposalReview
nodes.summary: React component rendering the proposal review step: trims proposal fields, tracks the per-extraction content edit/preview mode, validates required fields via useFieldValidity, and dispatches edits and resolutions through the extraction controller.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionSourceActions.tsx
nodes.summary: Sticky action bar for the source-selection step, showing the selected source count and detail level and driving proposal generation or cancellation from the extraction controller state.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionSourceActions
nodes.summary: Derives selected-source counts and generate-button labels from the controller status (generating, reviewing, source_invalid) and triggers controller.generateProposal.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionSourceOption.tsx
nodes.summary: Selectable source rows for the extraction picker: one variant for discussion messages and one for frozen-context items, each showing selection state, disabled reasons, and per-source validation issues.

nodes.name: SelectionIndicator
nodes.summary: Renders the checkbox-style tick indicating whether a source row is currently selected.

nodes.name: SourceIssue
nodes.summary: Renders the inline explanation for a source that failed server-side validation (missing, cross-project, cross-discussion, or inaccessible).

nodes.name: MessageSource
nodes.summary: Selectable row for a discussion message source; reads selection membership from the controller and toggles it via controller.toggleMessage while surfacing thread position and validation issues.

nodes.name: FrozenContextSource
nodes.summary: Selectable row for a frozen-context item source, toggling membership via controller.toggleFrozenContextItem and rendering issue and disabled states.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionSourceSelection.tsx
nodes.summary: Multi-step source-selection screen for knowledge extraction: lists eligible discussion messages and frozen-context items, offers detail-level presets and free-form instructions, and surfaces field-level and per-source validation errors.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports KNOWLEDGE_EXTRACTION_INSTRUCTIONS_MAX_LENGTH from @nuee/shared-types so the client honours the same limit the server enforces rather than re-declaring it.

nodes.name: sourceIssue
nodes.summary: Looks up the validation issue matching a given source kind and identifier from the controller issue list.

nodes.name: StepHeading
nodes.summary: Renders a numbered step heading with an optional aside for the selection wizard layout.

nodes.name: FieldError
nodes.summary: Renders an accessible, id-addressable field-level error message used by the instruction and source fieldsets.

nodes.name: KnowledgeExtractionSourceSelection
nodes.summary: Composes the full source-selection step: memoizes eligible messages and context items, wires select-all and per-source toggles, manages detail level and instructions, and focuses the first invalid source on validation failure.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Public barrel for the knowledge-extraction feature, re-exporting the discard dialog, proposal review, source actions and selection components, analytics helpers, source helpers, state machine, target-selection contract, and the useKnowledgeExtraction hook.

nodes.name: knowledgeExtractionAnalytics.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the privacy-preserving analytics payload for an extraction generation attempt, bucketing instruction length and estimated request payload size into bands instead of emitting raw content.
nodes.languageNotes: Free-text instructions are reduced to length bands so no user content leaves the client in analytics events.

nodes.name: instructionsLengthBand
nodes.summary: Maps the trimmed instruction string to a coarse length band so analytics never carries the instruction text itself.

nodes.name: payloadSizeBand
nodes.summary: Maps an estimated UTF-8 payload byte length to a coarse size band for telemetry.

nodes.name: knowledgeExtractionGenerationMetrics
nodes.summary: Computes the generation-attempt metrics — eligible and selected message and context counts, select-all usage, detail level, and instruction and payload bands — from the discussion and current selection.

nodes.name: knowledgeExtractionSources.ts
nodes.summary: Pure helpers that decide which discussion messages and frozen-context items are eligible extraction sources and produce stable ref keys for the selection UI.

nodes.name: knowledgeExtractionSourceRefKey
nodes.summary: Builds a stable composite key from a source kind and identifier so the selection UI can register per-source DOM refs.

nodes.name: eligibleKnowledgeExtractionMessages
nodes.summary: Filters a discussion down to the messages with non-empty content that may be used as extraction sources.

nodes.name: eligibleKnowledgeExtractionContextItems
nodes.summary: Filters a discussion frozen context to v1 items with non-empty frozen content that may be used as extraction sources.

nodes.name: hasEligibleKnowledgeExtractionSource
nodes.summary: Reports whether a discussion has at least one eligible message or frozen-context item, used to gate the extraction entry point.

nodes.name: knowledgeExtractionStateMachine.ts
nodes.summary: Framework-independent reducer and type surface for the knowledge-extraction workflow, defining every status from idle through selecting, generating, reviewing, target selection, saving, and the resolved or discarded terminals, plus the typed failure kinds.
nodes.languageNotes: Discriminated unions model both events and failures, so each failure kind (generation, source_validation, resolution, target_changed) carries exactly the fields its recovery path needs.

nodes.name: normalizeIdentifiers
nodes.summary: Trims, de-duplicates, and preserves ordering of a source identifier list so equivalent selections produce identical state.

nodes.name: normalizeKnowledgeExtractionSelection
nodes.summary: Normalizes a full selection (message ids, frozen-context ids, instructions, detail level) into its canonical form.

nodes.name: knowledgeExtractionSelectionFingerprint
nodes.summary: Produces a stable JSON fingerprint of a normalized selection with sorted identifiers, used to detect whether the selection changed since the last generation attempt.

nodes.name: hasKnowledgeExtractionSources
nodes.summary: Predicate reporting whether a selection contains at least one message or frozen-context source.

nodes.name: createKnowledgeExtractionState
nodes.summary: Builds the initial idle extraction state for a project and discussion binding, with an empty selection and its fingerprint.

nodes.name: selectingState
nodes.summary: Transitions into the selecting status, seeding the selection with an optional initial message id.

nodes.name: terminalState
nodes.summary: Builds a terminal state (resolved or discarded) carrying the resolution response and clearing in-flight failure data.

nodes.name: resolutionMatchesSavingState
nodes.summary: Guards a resolved event against the saving status that produced it, so a stale resolution cannot complete the wrong save path.

nodes.name: knowledgeExtractionReducer
nodes.summary: Pure reducer mapping every extraction event onto the next state, enforcing legal transitions, failure retention, retry counting, and selection-fingerprint invalidation.

nodes.name: knowledgeExtractionTargetSelection.ts
nodes.summary: Declares the KnowledgeExtractionTargetSelectionRequest contract that knowledge-extraction hands to the workspace so the canvas can host bubble target selection without owning the extraction lifecycle.
nodes.languageNotes: A typed callback port keeps target-selection ownership in knowledge-extraction while the workspace supplies only the selection surface.

nodes.name: useKnowledgeExtraction.ts
nodes.summary: Hook that drives the whole extraction workflow: exposes the controller surface (start, selection mutators, generateProposal, editProposal, target selection, approve, reject, discard, reset) over the state machine, with abort handling, attempt idempotency keys, response normalization, and analytics.
nodes.languageNotes: Requests are injectable props defaulting to the API module, and refs hold the current callbacks and an operation counter so aborted or superseded attempts cannot apply stale results.

nodes.name: normalizeSourceIssues
nodes.summary: Validates and de-duplicates the server source-issue list at runtime, keeping only entries with a known reason and a non-empty source id.

nodes.name: generationFailure
nodes.summary: Maps a thrown error into the retryable generation failure shape consumed by the reducer.

nodes.name: sourceValidationFailure
nodes.summary: Maps a source-validation ApiError into the non-retryable failure shape carrying field errors and per-source issues.

nodes.name: normalizeFieldErrors
nodes.summary: Filters the server field-error map down to the known extraction request fields with non-empty messages.

nodes.name: resolutionFailure
nodes.summary: Maps a thrown error into the retryable resolution failure shape used when approving or rejecting a proposal.

nodes.name: targetChangedFailure
nodes.summary: Detects the KNOWLEDGE_EXTRACTION_TARGET_CHANGED conflict and converts it into the non-retryable target-changed failure.

nodes.name: selectionInput
nodes.summary: Projects the current state selection into the create-extraction request payload.

nodes.name: isUnresolvedServerAttempt
nodes.summary: Reports whether a state holds a server-side extraction that was never resolved, so it can be discarded on a best-effort basis.

nodes.name: useKnowledgeExtraction
nodes.summary: Builds the KnowledgeExtractionController: holds the reducer state in refs, aborts superseded operations, generates attempt ids for idempotent retries, best-effort discards orphaned server attempts, and emits generation and resolution analytics.

nodes.name: main.tsx
nodes.summary: Vite entry point that mounts the App component into the #root element inside React StrictMode and loads the global stylesheet.

nodes.name: CreateProjectDialog.documents.test.tsx
nodes.summary: Vitest suite asserting that CreateProjectDialog persists the project before handing optional selected files off to the document library, preserving the create-then-upload ordering.

nodes.name: CreateProjectDialog.tsx
nodes.summary: Modal dialog for creating a project: validates title and description, loads the document upload policy to describe accepted file types, and hands any optionally selected files to the document library only after the project is created.
nodes.languageNotes: Request functions (createProject, getDocumentUploadPolicy) are injectable props so tests supply fakes instead of mocking the API module.

nodes.name: CreateProjectDialog
nodes.summary: Renders and coordinates the project-creation modal: field validity, abortable document-policy fetch, submit state, and the ordered create-then-hand-off-files flow with analytics.
